name: mirage
text: Confirmed: your Kalshi cash is split across shards (#0 $0.34, #1 $5.95, #2 $0, #3 $0), and an order can only spend the shard its market trades on. That's why every bet said insufficient. v1.0.58 is building: when an order is refused for balance it moves your cash from the other shards to that market's shard (inside your own Kalshi account only, at most once a minute per market) and sends the order again. I'll tell you when it's out.
